description: This file defines a PassManager class and related utility functions for managing and executing a sequence of passes with constraints, primarily used in a compiler or transformation pipeline within the PyTorch FX framework.

classes.name: PassManager
classes.description: Class for managing a sequence of passes with constraints, including validation and execution.

methods.name: inplace_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps a function to modify an object in place and return it.

methods.name: log_hook
methods.description: Wraps a function to log its output at a specified logging level.

methods.name: loop_pass
methods.description: Creates a pass that applies a base pass multiple times, either a fixed number of times or until a predicate fails.

methods.name: _validate_pass_schedule_constraint
methods.description: Validates that a list of passes satisfies a given dependency constraint.

methods.name: this_before_that_pass_constraint
methods.description: Defines a dependency constraint where one pass must occur before another.

methods.name: these_before_those_pass_constraint
methods.description: Defines a dependency constraint where a set of passes must occur before another set.
